scope: Atomic clarification and verification allocation across all 60 parent requirements. Supporting tests, full campaigns, current execution and independent approval remain distinct. No historical result is inherited.

obligations.statement: The guided machine shall complete initial checks before entering preparation.
obligations.acceptance: All seven test bits, three safe samples, no alarm and configured test duration are required. Missing integrity retains self_test.
obligations.coverage: Complete guided phase/action/guard, endpoint and reset unit matrices now executable; independent approval remains pending.

obligations.statement: Priming shall end on delivered flush volume.
obligations.acceptance: Below prime_mL retain priming; at or above target with safe guard enter configuration and set primed. The crossing-tick transfer bounds overshoot.
obligations.coverage: Complete guided phase/action/guard, endpoint and reset unit matrices now executable; independent approval remains pending.

obligations.statement: Isolated priming and cleaning shall not remove or return patient water.
obligations.acceptance: Patient draw/return are zero during isolated flush; body and source/waste balances independently remain within 1e-6 mL/mmol.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Starting treatment shall require priming and an explicit patient connection.
obligations.acceptance: Reject START before CONNECT. CONNECT is accepted only from primed configuration; connected alone does not start flow.
obligations.coverage: Complete guided phase/action/guard, endpoint and reset unit matrices now executable; independent approval remains pending.

obligations.statement: Treatment duration shall count delivered treatment time.
obligations.acceptance: A pause does not consume treatment duration; automatic finished occurs at the configured endpoint and preserves accumulated time across resume.
obligations.coverage: Complete guided phase/action/guard, endpoint and reset unit matrices now executable; independent approval remains pending.

obligations.statement: Blood return shall start only by confirmed request after treatment.
obligations.acceptance: RETURN requires finished and patient_connected; completion on returned_mL >= return_target_mL enters disconnecting. UF/substitution are off during return.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Disinfection shall require explicit disconnection and both endpoint conditions.
obligations.acceptance: CLEAN is rejected until disconnected. Complete only when configured duration and flush target have both been reached.
obligations.coverage: Complete guided phase/action/guard, endpoint and reset unit matrices now executable; independent approval remains pending.

obligations.statement: Alarm handling shall not restart circulation.
obligations.acceptance: ACK/silence do not clear restrictions. Reset requires recovery with three safe observations; guided restart requires separate RESUME. Terminal stop cannot resume.
obligations.coverage: Complete guided phase/action/guard, endpoint and reset unit matrices now executable; independent approval remains pending.

obligations.statement: The guided view shall display authoritative phase progress.
obligations.acceptance: Priming/return use volume fractions, therapy delivered time, cleaning the lesser time/volume fraction. Manual/stale/blocked/zero-flow estimates do not display a running ETA.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Only permitted treatment operations shall be presented.
obligations.acceptance: CONNECT visible only in eligible connection state; blocked/stale views suppress mutations; STOP remains available across tabs. Server guards also reject forbidden requests.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Blood and active substitution rates shall be editable during safe therapy.
obligations.acceptance: Accept confirmed blood 0..500 and HDF substitution 2..120 mL/min with sum <=500. HD requires substitution zero. Reject mode/net-UF changes during therapy. Preserve treatment time.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: A confirmation shall not apply to a different process session.
obligations.acceptance: Reject stale epoch and clear pending client state after session replacement; do not retry ambiguous critical requests automatically.
obligations.coverage: Direct old-confirmation rejection after session replacement; independent acceptance pending.

obligations.statement: Any failed decision STEP shall prevent committing that tick.
obligations.acceptance: Attempt both services; if either RPC fails, send no COMMIT/ADVANCE, request HALT, query stop separately and abort. Exercise lost replies after command acceptance.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Plant arbitration shall enforce the union of active restrictions.
obligations.acceptance: A conflicting positive demand cannot remove an active mask; simultaneous hazards restrict all affected outputs before the next integration.
obligations.coverage: Actual plant/patient pipe campaign covers every single and pair mask in five active phases. IPC/deployment independence remains a separate gate.

obligations.statement: Invalid protection observations shall constrain outputs before integration.
obligations.acceptance: Sequence/time/validity must match the current frozen sample; invalid, missing, stale, future or replayed samples are unusable. No tick commits unrestricted outputs on an unusable protection sample.
obligations.coverage: All five freshness faults on both roles exercised on the current guided plant. Wall-clock service loss remains separately tested.

obligations.statement: Wall-clock liveness shall remain distinct from virtual pause.
obligations.acceptance: Nominal lease 2000 ms; tested wall acceptance <=3 s. PING while paused does not increment virtual sequence or physiology.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Failed-run evidence shall survive unsuccessful collection.
obligations.acceptance: Keep original error identity, available diagnostics and partial records. If extraction fails, retain volumes and usable recovery instructions before any cleanup.
obligations.coverage: Direct extraction failure/retention case; other collection phases covered by adjacent suite methods.

obligations.statement: Water accounting shall separate patient, circuit, gross UF and substitution.
obligations.acceptance: For current physical HD/PRE/POST complete cycles, independent cumulative water residual <=1e-6 mL. Net meter is gross UF minus substitution, not patient weight.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Distributed transport shall conserve every tracked solute.
obligations.acceptance: Six-species whole-system and dialysate-ledger residuals <=1e-6 mmol; local compartment sums agree with aggregate inventories.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Red cells and proteins shall remain explicitly accounted for.
obligations.acceptance: Vascular + circuit + lost red cells/protein equal initial inventory to 1e-6 mL/g; local Hct and Cp must agree with inventories and volumes.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Needle geometry shall affect hydraulic resistance.
obligations.acceptance: With viscosity and length fixed, resistance is proportional to diameter^-4; use internal diameter in mm and explicit SI conversions.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Chamber level changes shall arise from retained liquid/gas inventories.
obligations.acceptance: Implicit liquid continuity and (760+P)*Vgas=gas_inventory hold; bounded gas actuation cannot directly reset liquid volume. Isolation freezes storage.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Pump flow, access draw and patient return shall remain distinguishable.
obligations.acceptance: Differences equal circuit storage change and membrane/substitution transfers, rather than being forced equal during transients.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Dialysate balance shall include compliant storage and extra UF removal.
obligations.acceptance: Storage change equals feed + membrane filtration - drain; independent recorded residual <=1e-5 mL. Valve changeover holds 30 ms, including smaller time steps.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Nonconverged hydraulic steps shall not report nominal flow.
obligations.acceptance: Forced solver-iteration exhaustion results in zero outputs and explicit hydraulic_solver limitation, not a successful nominal target.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: PRE and POST shall enter different retained blood compartments.
obligations.acceptance: PRE enters filter segment 1; POST enters venous chamber. Concentration changes propagate through downstream cells rather than instantaneous whole-circuit mixing.
obligations.coverage: Transit/atomic-rejection fixture exists; route allocation also relies on physical three-mode cycles.

obligations.statement: Prepared-fluid heating and supply shall respect finite resources.
obligations.acceptance: Acid and bicarbonate decrement independently; bicarbonate dissolves at bounded rate; heater power remains 0..configured maximum and thermal balance includes storage and flow.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Observable preparation faults shall inhibit unsafe modeled fluid delivery.
obligations.acceptance: Observed temperature outside 35..39 C, conductivity outside 12..16 mS/cm, integrity failure or other declared quality hazards constrain delivery before commit. Hidden contamination alone is not an invented observable.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: Reference fitting shall keep a separate comparison point.
obligations.acceptance: Fit only the 300 mL/min urea point, compare 400 mL/min at stated conditions; 5% relative holdout criterion is an engineering comparison. Report other coefficients as uncalibrated.
obligations.coverage: direct assertion or named fixture; current result acceptance pending

obligations.statement: C++ and Python current device decoders shall share numeric bounds.
obligations.acceptance: For MACHINE5/8 and OBS5/8/9/10 accept each boundary and reject below/above, nonfinite, missing and surplus values in both actual decoders.
obligations.coverage: Field-by-field numeric and arity campaign; physical plausibility and clock matching remain semantic checks.

obligations.statement: Accepted initial dialysate volume shall be usable by plant and patient initialization.
obligations.acceptance: Current dynamic machine domain is 50..1000 mL inclusive; Python outer validator and C++ plant agree, and both endpoints initialize the patient successfully.
obligations.coverage: Real C++ initialization and Python patient; no upper-domain expansion implied.

obligations.statement: Each source line shall retain its configured internal volume and initial air, water or concentrate occupancy up to the mixing junction.
obligations.acceptance: Exercise dry, wetted and residual-liquid starts; downstream arrival follows displaced volume and conserves inventories. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Acid and bicarbonate shall have distinct metering pumps with command and actual transfer represented separately.
obligations.acceptance: Exercise zero command, pressure load, air aspiration and actuator saturation; actual liquid delivery follows the declared pump law, not commanded displacement alone. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: The cartridge shall separately account for liquid volume, gas inventory, solid bicarbonate and dissolved bicarbonate.
obligations.acceptance: Fill and withdraw from known initial inventories; storage changes match all boundary transfers and inventories remain nonnegative. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Cartridge pressure shall respond to gas compression, liquid transfer and declared vent paths.
obligations.acceptance: Block vent, restrict inlet and increase withdrawal; pressure follows the declared law and limit violations inhibit the conflicting actuator before the allocated deadline. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Dissolution shall depend on the declared saturation relation, available solid and finite dissolution kinetics.
obligations.acceptance: At adequate residence time approach saturation; under dissolution-limited withdrawal remain below saturation despite remaining solid. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Solid exhaustion shall not erase remaining dissolved bicarbonate.
obligations.acceptance: Exhaust solid and continue water throughput; dissolved inventory washes out conservatively rather than disappearing or remaining indefinitely constant. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Acid concentration shall be a configurable source property, distinct from remaining bag volume.
obligations.acceptance: Apply nominal, diluted and exhausted-source cases; concentration and delivered mass change consistently, including configured air ingress after depletion. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Downstream mixing shall conserve species and liquid storage and represent declared transport delays.
obligations.acceptance: Compare a well-mixed tank with its analytic step response and transport with volume/flow delay; verify independent inventory residuals. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Control shall use simulated sensor outputs with timestamps, temperature compensation, latency and validity rather than hidden source inventory.
obligations.acceptance: Inject delayed, stale, invalid and air-exposed measurements; invalid signals cannot authorize readiness. Changing hidden inventory alone cannot directly change a control decision with identical sensor history. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Each metering command shall combine declared feedforward with bounded PI correction and defined anti-windup/invalid-measurement behavior.
obligations.acceptance: Apply flow/concentration steps, saturation and invalidity; commands remain bounded, integrator behavior matches the specified policy and recovery meets prospective response criteria. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Composition qualification shall include intermediate observations and ratio checks rather than final conductivity alone.
obligations.acceptance: Construct compensating acid/bicarbonate errors with similar final conductivity; documented intermediate checks detect the observable cases and remaining detection gaps are reported. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Acid and bicarbonate startup sequences shall progress independently with observable guards and bounded failure timeouts.
obligations.acceptance: Hold each prerequisite false in turn; reject premature dosing qualification and enter the declared failure response on timeout. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: The preparation supervisor shall divert unqualified fluid to waste and prevent its delivery to the dialyzer/substitution paths.
obligations.acceptance: Challenge every startup phase, each invalid guard and loss of qualification; verify actual routed volumes, not just displayed state. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Readiness shall require valid liquid-presence evidence, acceptable pressure/composition and continuous stability for a configured dwell interval.
obligations.acceptance: Test just below/at/above the dwell boundary and an intervening invalid sample; interruptions reset qualification and a single valid sample cannot authorize delivery. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: The model shall provide separate boundary ledgers for source supply, stored liquid/species, gas exchange, waste and usable output.
obligations.acceptance: Independently reconstruct balances across startup, zero flow, partial steps and exhaustion; refinements of timestep and transport discretization satisfy predeclared error budgets. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Preparation evidence shall identify requirements, implementation revision, parameters, test oracle and execution outcome.
obligations.acceptance: Reproduce a fixed scenario and verify complete trace in both directions; changed source/configuration invalidates prior applicability. Bounds fixed in STP-MIX-01.
obligations.coverage: Implemented synthetic candidate. Full preparation suite also covers three real Plant/patient cycles, all occupancy starts and eight-hour depletion. Empirical/independent acceptance remains open.

obligations.statement: Treatment home shall show a large simplified external dialyzer and extracorporeal circuit with directional flow and explicit HD / HDF PRE / HDF POST routing. Roller pumps, chamber detail, containers and full plumbing shall be available in dedicated Blood circuit and Hydraulics tabs. Render each mode and assert active branches and view allocation.
obligations.acceptance: Proposed engineering criteria recorded before implementation in the design. No independent acceptance is inferred from execution.
obligations.coverage: Synthetic telemetry and real LVGL rendering/pointer checks; Unix IPC and physical touch hardware are separate gates.

obligations.statement: Motion shall use current valid observed/model telemetry, never prescribed flow. Zero flow freezes phase; stale/invalid telemetry freezes motion and displays its status, without portraying unknown as zero. Changing flow preserves phase. Unit checks exercise zero, restart, rate changes and loss/recovery of freshness.
obligations.acceptance: Proposed engineering criteria recorded before implementation in the design. No independent acceptance is inferred from execution.
obligations.coverage: Synthetic telemetry and real LVGL rendering/pointer checks; Unix IPC and physical touch hardware are separate gates.

obligations.statement: Pump activity and fluid passage shall be distinguished. Concentrate drive and delivered liquid require separate versioned observations; older observations show unavailable fields. No mechanical RPM shall be claimed. Test C++/Python round trips and a dry-line fixture.
obligations.acceptance: Proposed engineering criteria recorded before implementation in the design. No independent acceptance is inferred from execution.
obligations.coverage: Synthetic telemetry and real LVGL rendering/pointer checks; Unix IPC and physical touch hardware are separate gates.

obligations.statement: Dialysate traversal, bypass and unknown route shall be distinguished with labels and valve/path geometry. Motion in a bypass shall not imply membrane traversal. Test bypass with positive feed and zero/unknown feed.
obligations.acceptance: Proposed engineering criteria recorded before implementation in the design. No independent acceptance is inferred from execution.
obligations.coverage: Synthetic telemetry and real LVGL rendering/pointer checks; Unix IPC and physical touch hardware are separate gates.

obligations.statement: Phase progress, phase/session time, net UF and substitution totals versus explicitly labelled current-prescription goals shall remain visible on home. Totals come from authoritative meters and survive pause/resume; no UI integration or invented target history. Test paused totals, HD, changed prescriptions and unavailable observations.
obligations.acceptance: Proposed engineering criteria recorded before implementation in the design. No independent acceptance is inferred from execution.
obligations.coverage: Synthetic telemetry and real LVGL rendering/pointer checks; Unix IPC and physical touch hardware are separate gates.

obligations.statement: Filled icons shall accompany text on navigation and actions. Guided controls shall have at least 48 logical pixels height; STOP shall remain visible outside scrollable content. Reflow shall support 800x890, 1100x890 and 1440x1000 without scaling hit targets. Test bounds, non-overlap and real LVGL rendering.
obligations.acceptance: Proposed engineering criteria recorded before implementation in the design. No independent acceptance is inferred from execution.
obligations.coverage: Synthetic telemetry and real LVGL rendering/pointer checks; Unix IPC and physical touch hardware are separate gates.

obligations.statement: Chamber fractions shall use measured fractions. Container bars shall be explicitly relative to first observed session inventory, with absolute quantities/units; missing baselines and unavailable telemetry shall not show fabricated capacity. Session changes reset presentation history. Test inventory depletion, stale data and reset.
obligations.acceptance: Proposed engineering criteria recorded before implementation in the design. No independent acceptance is inferred from execution.
obligations.coverage: Synthetic telemetry and real LVGL rendering/pointer checks; Unix IPC and physical touch hardware are separate gates.

obligations.statement: A reduced-motion toggle shall freeze decorative motion without hiding numerical values, route, status or progress. Motion limits shall be visible and documented. Verify freeze and continued value updates.
obligations.acceptance: Proposed engineering criteria recorded before implementation in the design. No independent acceptance is inferred from execution.
obligations.coverage: Synthetic telemetry and real LVGL rendering/pointer checks; Unix IPC and physical touch hardware are separate gates.

obligations.statement: Dialysate outlet and bypass shall remain outside the venous chamber and lead to effluent. POST substitution shall enter a dedicated venous-chamber inlet; PRE enters before the filter. Blood enters above and leaves below. Non-joining crossings shall have visible clearance.
obligations.acceptance: Exact intended connector endpoints and no dialysate intersection with the venous-chamber rectangle in actual HD/PRE/POST, bypass and stale renders at all three test sizes. A separate POST tracer check uses an independent scalar mixing oracle with 1e-12 mmol/L tolerance and existing 1e-6 mmol residual limit. Proposed engineering criteria; no bubble-capture or independent usability acceptance.
obligations.coverage: Actual drawn segment endpoints and chamber exclusion in all fixture sizes, modes, bypass and stale states; additional POST tracer regression in test_synoptic. No bubble-trap validation.

obligations.statement: Home shall prioritize the filter and extracorporeal flow with a simplified overview, animated fluid-direction cues and measured acid/bicarbonate liquid, dialysate feed, drain, membrane UF and substitution quantities in mL/min. Mechanical roller motion, tanks and full valve plumbing shall be confined to the Blood circuit and Hydraulics tabs. PRE/POST destination, bypass, zero/unknown flow, freshness and reduced motion remain explicit. Test distinct render modes, actual tab events, source-to-value mapping and simplified topology at all three fixture sizes.
obligations.acceptance: Proposed engineering criteria recorded before implementation in the design. No independent acceptance is inferred from execution.
obligations.coverage: Synthetic telemetry and real LVGL rendering/pointer checks; Unix IPC and physical touch hardware are separate gates.

obligations.statement: Run production C++ Plant, control/protection decisions and existing Python patient/physical coupling locally using WebAssembly and Pyodide. HD/PRE/POST must reach treatment with finite results and conserved water/solute inventories; no replacement physical equations or prerecorded telemetry.
obligations.acceptance: Criteria declared before execution; native/Wasm comparison and real Chromium UI gates.
obligations.coverage: Selected synthetic full cycles and browser interactions; no process isolation, independent usability approval, long-duration/mobile qualification or global numerical closure.

obligations.statement: Render existing LVGL guided views in a browser canvas with touch/pointer input and working lifecycle actions, prescription, STOP, detail tabs and reduced motion. Keep simulation time independent of animation frame rate.
obligations.acceptance: Criteria declared before execution; native/Wasm comparison and real Chromium UI gates.
obligations.coverage: Selected synthetic full cycles and browser interactions; no process isolation, independent usability approval, long-duration/mobile qualification or global numerical closure.

obligations.statement: Compare the same deterministic scenarios/commands and initial conditions in native and WebAssembly execution. Discrete stages/alarms must match exactly; finite numeric outputs use abs(a-b) <= 1e-8 + 1e-9*max(abs(a),abs(b)), in each field's documented units. Water and solute conservation retain existing 1e-6 mL/mmol bounds. These are proposed portability budgets, not global numerical accuracy approval.
obligations.acceptance: Criteria declared before execution; native/Wasm comparison and real Chromium UI gates.
obligations.coverage: Selected synthetic full cycles and browser interactions; no process isolation, independent usability approval, long-duration/mobile qualification or global numerical closure.

obligations.statement: Serve static assets only; computation and patient state stay in the browser. Pause when hidden, do not catch up elapsed wall time, prevent overlapping ticks; stop advancing after runtime failure and report unavailable state. Reset must discard queued actions and old patient state.
obligations.acceptance: Criteria declared before execution; native/Wasm comparison and real Chromium UI gates.
obligations.coverage: Selected synthetic full cycles and browser interactions; no process isolation, independent usability approval, long-duration/mobile qualification or global numerical closure.

obligations.statement: Pin toolchain/runtime dependencies, preserve source/configuration identifiers, build instructions and native/Wasm comparison results. Published build must identify its source and dependency artifacts.
obligations.acceptance: Criteria declared before execution; native/Wasm comparison and real Chromium UI gates.
obligations.coverage: Selected synthetic full cycles and browser interactions; no process isolation, independent usability approval, long-duration/mobile qualification or global numerical closure.

obligations.statement: Delayed manual PRIME must remain usable beyond the batch horizon in an explicitly interactive session.
obligations.acceptance: HD/PRE/POST wait 2400 ticks then confirmed PRIME and complete lifecycle, zero alarms, conservation and native/Wasm budgets retained; batch limit and STOP retained.
obligations.coverage: Finite synthetic delayed-start regression; independent review, arbitrary duration and cross-browser/device qualification remain open.

obligations.statement: Reflow the production LVGL guided interface for phone and landscape widths with readable controls, retained actions, scrolling and resize confirmation cancellation.
obligations.acceptance: Prospective criteria in docs/design/BROWSER_RUNTIME.md; pH availability and actual iPhone hardware qualification remain explicit.
obligations.coverage: Synthetic native LVGL plus browser viewport; no physical iPhone/Safari qualification. pH absent from live contract.

obligations.statement: Show arterial red, venous blue and fresh dialysate quality green only for all three valid in-range measurements; orange for known out-of-range and neutral for incomplete quality.
obligations.acceptance: Prospective criteria in docs/design/BROWSER_RUNTIME.md; pH availability and actual iPhone hardware qualification remain explicit.
